title: MLBClient Launcher Beta 1 launches on 15 November
excerpt: The first public beta of the MLBClient Launcher arrives on Sunday, 15 November 2026 at 16:00 CET, together with MLBClient 0.1.0-beta and the free Launch Collection.
body:
The first public beta of the **MLBClient Launcher** arrives on **Sunday, 15 November 2026 at 16:00 CET**.

MLBClient is a standalone launcher for Minecraft Java Edition. Log in with your Microsoft account, press Install, and the launcher sets up Minecraft, Fabric, Java and the MLBClient client for you.

## What is in Beta 1

- **Profiles** with their own folders for mods, configs and worlds
- **Mods from Modrinth** and modpack import (Modrinth `.mrpack` and CurseForge Fabric packs)
- **MLBClient 0.1.0-beta** for Minecraft 26.2 and 26.3, and QuickClient as a second client
- **Emotes and cosmetics** that other MLBClient players can see
- **Shop with daily credits**: unlock emotes and cosmetics, no real money

## Launch Collection

Four release emotes, *The Launch*, *MLB Hype*, *The Comeback* and *New Era*, are free for one week from the beta launch.

## Good to know

This is a beta. The installer is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you (More info › Run anyway). Report bugs in the Discord.

[Join the MLBClient Discord](https://discord.gg/UrWXmaFQCE) · [Watch the trailer](https://youtu.be/HVJCQes5Kx4)
